text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was on the way back from shopping with 
Sakura Laurel at the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Trainer, are you taking on the 
challenge too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a ticket. Since we're 
here, why don't we draw together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, we'll split it right down the 
middle♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Pushed along by Sakura Laurel, I was 
forced into the lottery raffle line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside her stubborn refusal to 
yield, we turned the raffle wheel crank 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Amazing, incredible! It says hot 
springs!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪ I'm so happy~...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ I like to try all the massage 
services they offer! Especially the 
acupuncture!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. You might get hooked too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, when should we go? With the 
momentum we have going now, I'd rather 
hold off on taking it easy, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going with me probably wouldn't let her 
relax. When I suggested it might be better 
to go with friends or family instead—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I believe you need a chance to 
rest too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because you train me on weekdays, and 
spend the weekends preparing for and 
studying races...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I think I deserve at least a little 
reward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So warm your legs up in the hot springs, 
and eat lots of delicious food!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that hot spring ticket from 
earlier comes with two separate rooms! 
You'll be able to let your hair down and 
relax too, you know? ...Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, plans were made to go on a hot 
spring trip with Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that meat looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But if we split one in half, it won't be 
enough to satisfy us, right...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The time has come for me to show off 
my culinary skills!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, let me treat you 
to French-style Salisbury steak... a 
*steak haché*.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It may not compare to a special hamburger 
steak made by a first-rate chef, but I 
hope you'll enjoy its home-cooked flavor♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the hamburger steaks Sakura Laurel 
made were lined up on the table one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, the Salisbury steak she made 
tasted better... or so it felt.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
All of this... Are you really sure I can 
have it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course! Go on, take it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Trainer-san. I did say we'd split it 
half and half earlier, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: May I be a little greedy?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hey everyone at Victory Club~! I brought 
souvenirs for all your hard work!! Let's 
eat together with Big Sis~!

text_block_list.name: Club Children
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, so many carrots~! They look tasty~! 
Can I take some for my mom?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, five each for everyone! Heheh, 
gotta get pleeeenty of nourishment in ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From upperclassman to underclassman. 
Sakura Laurel looked delighted to fulfill 
her role as a giver and mentor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa, yay~! You won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A win's a win! I'm just lucky I didn't 
draw a blank.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Since my luck is pretty good today, maybe 
more good things are on the way?"
choice_data_list: Hmm... sure hope there is one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes♪ Let's both stay positive!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, nothing particularly good 
happened for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Sakura Laurel, walking alongside, 
wore a slightly proud expression on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah... They got meee...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Trainer, it's not like you're in 
the wrong at all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It just means neither of us was lucky 
today. Just like drawing 'Bad Luck' at the 
shrine, let's be more careful with 
everything than usual—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, didn't we just go shopping a 
moment ago?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we don't have anything on us right 
now, do we...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Sakura Laurel and I ended up 
having to rush right back to the shop 
where we'd just bought everything...
